verdict.rationale: `$skill-installer <name>` is a skill invoked inside Codex itself, so the agent can install curated skills by name (e.g. `$skill-installer linear`). `codex plugin marketplace add` gives a scriptable CLI path for adding marketplace sources. Skills are plain `SKILL.md` directories that Codex discovers from `.agents/skills`, so an agent could also drop one in place. However, plugin install goes through the interactive `/plugins` browser and requires starting a new session, and no doc confirms a fully promptless, headless run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a non-interactive/headless install mode with no confirmation prompts, a scriptable plugin-install CLI command (beyond adding marketplaces), and hands-on corroboration of an agent completing an install end to end.
